description:
Turkey tail mushroom Capsule extract

Turkey Tail Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

For thousands of years, ‘Turkey Tail’ has been praised in the East. This turkey tail mushroom extract is highly regard in Japan, China and the rest of Asia, where it is traditionally consume mainly in tea. When you look at the fruiting body of Turkey Tail, it looks suspiciously like the, you guessed it, a turkey’s tail! This species grows mainly on broken branches and stumps from the forest from which it feeds and takes care of the decomposition process. The Foodsporen® Turkey Tail extract, like all their products, is made from the fruiting bodies of this special mushroom. Foodsporen® does not use the mycelium grown on grain. In this way they offer you an honest, powerful and pure product. In addition, all Foodsporen® extracts, and therefore also the Foodsporen® Turkey Tail capsules, are standardize at no less than 30% polysaccharides!

Foodsporen® only uses the fruiting bodies for each of its products. No fillers or mycelia grown on grains. The Turkey Tail capsules have a concentration ratio of no less than 12:1.

The capsules come in a sealed Miron glass bottle to ensure longevity it’s constituents. The bottle is UV protective and is consider optimal for the storage of herbs and supplements.

Number of doses:

60 capsules

Turkey tail mushroom Capsule extract powder product information | Turkey Tail Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

Per capsule (400mg):

Turkey Tail (12:1) (Coriolus versicolor) fruiting body extract 400mg

Usage:

1 capsule 1 or 2 times daily. Do not take with carbonated drinks or medicines.

Suitable for:

Vegetarians and vegans

Not suitable for:

During pregnancy, breastfeeding and/or an allergy to one of the ingredients. If in doubt, consult your doctor or pharmacist.

Ingredients inTurkey tail mushroom Capsule | Turkey Tail Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules :

Turkey Tail (Coriolus versicolor), Microcrystalline Cellulose, Hypromellose (Vegetable Capsule)
